t: This is the Novo Cemetery, a Sephardic Jewish burial ground on the grounds of Queen Mary University of London in Mile End. It opened in 1733 and is one of only two exclusively Sephardic cemeteries left in England. It's Grade Two listed. Buried here is Daniel Mendoza, the bare-knuckle boxer who became the first Jewish English heavyweight champion. Also here is the banker Sampson Gideon, who financed the government against the Jacobite rising of 1745. Sir Francis Montefiore, a Sephardic communal leader and Zionist, and the physician Jacob de Castro Sarmento are buried here too.
